notes: One representative open-source repository per language supported by the indexer (12 grammars: TSX is measured inside the TypeScript repo, and JavaScript also goes through the TSX grammar). Checkouts live in bench/repos/<name> (gitignored, read-only, never built or executed): git clone --depth 1 --branch <tag> <url> bench/repos/<name>, or `kopt bench all --clone`. files/loc = files and newline count of the primary language in `git ls-files` at the tag (tests and fixtures included). Gold items avoid enterprise-licensed parts of medusa and meilisearch.

repos.name: spring-framework
repos.reason: Reference enterprise Java framework (DI container, transactions, MVC). Large multi-module Gradle build; several tasks target APIs new in 7.0 (core.retry, resilience, API versioning) that models cannot answer from memory.

repos.name: django
repos.reason: Large, idiomatic Python web framework (ORM, migrations, middleware, templates) with deep package nesting and dynamic dispatch.

repos.name: medusa
repos.reason: Enterprise commerce platform: TypeScript monorepo of domain modules (order, cart, payment, inventory), a workflow engine with compensation, DI container and a large React/TSX admin dashboard. Less famous internals than Angular or NestJS.

repos.name: webpack
repos.reason: Large plain-JavaScript (CommonJS, JSDoc-typed) codebase with a plugin/hook architecture; ~15k JS files of which most are test cases, which stresses ranking and test demotion.

repos.name: jellyfin
repos.reason: Enterprise-style .NET application: ASP.NET Core controllers, dependency injection, EF Core data layer, background tasks and a plugin system. Read-only use.

repos.name: gitea
repos.reason: Large Go application with a classic layered layout (models, services, routers, modules), many packages sharing short names, which stresses Go reference resolution.

repos.name: exposed
repos.reason: Kotlin SQL framework (DSL + DAO, JDBC and R2DBC) built on extension functions, objects and DSL builders: typical of enterprise Kotlin data access.

repos.name: meilisearch
repos.reason: Rust application (search engine with an HTTP API, task scheduler and indexing pipeline) organized as a Cargo workspace; traits, impl blocks and macros.

repos.name: laravel
repos.reason: The dominant PHP framework (container, Eloquent ORM, queues, routing); namespaces, traits, facades and magic methods. Tasks favour less-known internals.

repos.name: discourse
repos.reason: Large Rails application (models, services, jobs, lib) with metaprogramming, concerns and a JavaScript frontend in the same repo. Read-only use.

repos.name: playframework
repos.reason: Enterprise web framework written in Scala with a Java API on top (mixed Scala/Java code base): implicits, case classes, traits, companion objects.
